+/// The deadreckon source checkout, when one is reachable. `$DEADRECKON_SOURCE_ROOT`
+/// wins; otherwise the workspace this binary was compiled from is probed. Installed
+/// release binaries return a path that does not exist on the user's machine, so
+/// callers must treat this as an optional last-tier fallback, never a requirement.
+pub fn source_root() -> Option<PathBuf> {
+    if let Some(root) = env::var_os("DEADRECKON_SOURCE_ROOT") {
+        return Some(PathBuf::from(root));
+    }
+    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))

=== DIFF: crates/deadreckon/tests/portability.rs ===
@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+#![allow(clippy::expect_used)]
+
+//! Guard: no developer-machine path may be compiled into the product or
+//! documented as the way to use it. The release-trust closure rider added this
+//! discipline for the test suite; this extends it to the shipped surface:
+//! crate sources (including fixtures and goldens), installers, the npm
+//! wrapper, the Makefile, and user-facing docs.
+
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+const FORBIDDEN: &str = concat!("/Users/", "gdc");
+
+const TEXT_EXTENSIONS: &[&str] = &[
+    "rs", "toml", "sh", "js", "mjs", "json", "md", "golden", "sql", "yml", "yaml", "txt", "cast",
+];
+
+#[test]
+fn no_developer_machine_paths_in_shipped_surface() {
+    let root = workspace_root();
+    let mut findings = Vec::new();
+    for dir in ["crates", "release", "npm"] {
+        scan_tree(&root.join(dir), &mut findings);
+    }
+    for file in ["Makefile", "HOWTO.md", "README.md", "dist-workspace.toml"] {
+        scan_file(&root.join(file), &mut findings);
+    }
+    assert!(
+        findings.is_empty(),
+        "developer-machine path {FORBIDDEN} found in shipped surface; \
+         derive from $HOME, DEADRECKON_HOME, or source_root() instead:\n{}",
+        findings.join("\n")
+    );
+}
+
+fn workspace_root() -> PathBuf {
+    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
+        .ancestors()
+        .nth(2)
+        .expect("workspace root")
+        .to_path_buf()
+}
+
+fn scan_tree(dir: &Path, findings: &mut Vec<String>) {
+    let entries = match fs::read_dir(dir) {
+        Ok(entries) => entries,
+        Err(_) => return,
+    };
+    for entry in entries.flatten() {
+        let path = entry.path();
+        let name = entry.file_name();
+        let name = name.to_string_lossy();
+        if path.is_dir() {
+            if name == "target" || name == ".git" || name == "node_modules" {
+                continue;
+            }
+            scan_tree(&path, findings);
+        } else if path
+            .extension()
+            .and_then(|ext| ext.to_str())
+            .is_some_and(|ext| TEXT_EXTENSIONS.contains(&ext))
+            || name.ends_with(".sh")
+            || !name.contains('.')
+        {
+            scan_file(&path, findings);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+fn scan_file(path: &Path, findings: &mut Vec<String>) {
+    let Ok(contents) = fs::read_to_string(path) else {
+        return;
+    };
+    for (idx, line) in contents.lines().enumerate() {
+        if line.contains(FORBIDDEN) {
+            findings.push(format!("{}:{}: {}", path.display(), idx + 1, line.trim()));
+        }
+    }
+}

215	pub fn workspace_scope(start: &Path) -> Result<String> {
216	    let root = env::var_os("DEADRECKON_SCOPE_ROOT")
217	        .map(PathBuf::from)
218	        .or_else(|| find_git_root(start))
219	        .unwrap_or_else(|| start.to_path_buf());
220	    let canonical = root.canonicalize().map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
221	        path: root.clone(),
222	        source,
223	    })?;
224	    let base = canonical
225	        .file_name()
226	        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
227	        .map(sanitize_slug)
228	        .filter(|name| !name.is_empty())
229	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "workspace".to_string());
230	    Ok(format!(
231	        "{base}-{:08x}",
232	        fnv1a32(canonical.to_string_lossy().as_ref())
233	    ))
234	}

236	pub fn task_key(goal: &str) -> String {
237	    let trimmed = goal.trim();
238	    let mut stem = sanitize_slug(trimmed);
239	    if stem.len() > 48 {
240	        stem.truncate(48);
241	        stem = stem.trim_end_matches('-').to_string();
242	    }
243	    if stem.is_empty() {
244	        stem = "task".to_string();
245	    }
246	    format!("{stem}-{:08x}", fnv1a32(trimmed))
247	}
248	
249	pub fn sanitize_slug(input: &str) -> String {
250	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(input.len());
251	    let mut last_dash = false;
252	    for ch in input.chars() {
253	        let next = if ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() {
254	            last_dash = false;
255	            Some(ch.to_ascii_lowercase())
256	        } else if matches!(ch, '-' | '_' | ' ' | '.') {
257	            if last_dash {
258	                None
259	            } else {
260	                last_dash = true;
261	                Some('-')
262	            }
263	        } else {
264	            None
265	        };
266	        if let Some(ch) = next {
267	            out.push(ch);
268	        }
269	    }
270	    out.trim_matches('-').to_string()
271	}
272	
273	fn find_git_root(start: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
274	    let mut cursor = if start.is_file() {
275	        start.parent()?.to_path_buf()
276	    } else {
277	        start.to_path_buf()
278	    };
279	    loop {
280	        if cursor.join(".git").exists() {
281	            return Some(cursor);
282	        }
283	        if !cursor.pop() {
284	            return None;
285	        }
286	    }
287	}
288	
289	fn fnv1a32(input: &str) -> u32 {
290	    let mut hash = 0x811c_9dc5u32;
291	    for byte in input.as_bytes() {
292	        hash ^= u32::from(*byte);
293	        hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x0100_0193);
294	    }
295	    hash
296	}

1	#!/bin/sh
2	set -eu
3	
4	repo="${DEADRECKON_REPO:-gregce/deadreckon}"
5	tag="${DEADRECKON_TAG:-latest}"
6	asset="${DEADRECKON_INSTALLER_ASSET:-deadreckon-installer.sh}"
7	if [ "$tag" = "latest" ]; then
8	  base_url="https://github.com/${repo}/releases/latest/download"
9	else
10	  base_url="https://github.com/${repo}/releases/download/${tag}"
11	fi
12	tmp="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/deadreckon-install.$$"
13	
14	die() {
15	  printf '%s\n' "deadreckon install: $*" >&2
16	  exit 1
17	}
18	
19	download() {
20	  url="$1"
21	  out="$2"
22	  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
23	    curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$out"
24	  elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
25	    wget -qO "$out" "$url"
26	  else
27	    die "install curl or wget, then rerun this installer"
28	  fi
29	}
30	
31	cleanup() {
32	  rm -rf "$tmp"
33	}
34	
35	trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
36	
37	(umask 077 && mkdir "$tmp") || die "could not create temp dir: $tmp"
38	
39	printf '%s\n' "deadreckon install: ${repo} ${tag}"
40	download "${base_url}/${asset}" "${tmp}/${asset}" || die "could not download ${base_url}/${asset}"
41	
42	if download "${base_url}/SHA256SUMS" "${tmp}/SHA256SUMS"; then
43	  if grep "  ${asset}\$" "${tmp}/SHA256SUMS" > "${tmp}/SHA256SUMS.${asset}"; then
44	    if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
45	      (cd "$tmp" && shasum -a 256 -c "SHA256SUMS.${asset}") \
46	        || die "checksum verification failed for ${asset}"
47	    elif command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
48	      (cd "$tmp" && sha256sum -c "SHA256SUMS.${asset}") \
49	        || die "checksum verification failed for ${asset}"
50	    else
51	      printf '%s\n' "deadreckon install: warning: shasum/sha256sum not found; skipping checksum verification" >&2
52	    fi
53	  else
54	    printf '%s\n' "deadreckon install: warning: ${asset} was not listed in SHA256SUMS" >&2
55	  fi
56	else
57	  printf '%s\n' "deadreckon install: warning: could not download SHA256SUMS; skipping checksum verification" >&2
58	fi
59	
60	sh "${tmp}/${asset}" "$@"
61	
62	installed="${DEADRECKON_BIN:-${HOME}/.local/share/deadreckon/bin/deadreckon}"
63	if [ -x "$installed" ]; then
64	  bin="$installed"
65	elif command -v deadreckon >/dev/null 2>&1; then
66	  bin="deadreckon"
67	else
68	  bin="$installed"
69	fi
70	
71	printf '\n%s\n' "deadreckon install: next"
72	printf '  %s\n' "${bin} doctor"
73	printf '  %s\n' "${bin} try"
74	printf '  %s\n' "${bin} start \"make a small safe change\""
75

203	    let working_dir = working_dir_for_codebase(&run_root, &codebase);
204	    fs::create_dir_all(&working_dir).with_path(&working_dir)?;
205	    fs::create_dir_all(run_root.join("snapshots")).with_path(run_root.join("snapshots"))?;
206	    let gate_dir = run_root.join("gate");

208	    fs::write(gate_dir.join("nonce"), Uuid::new_v4().simple().to_string())
209	        .with_path(gate_dir.join("nonce"))?;
210	
211	    // AS-BUILT §3: the binary owns deterministic paths while the skill stays a
212	    // markdown subprocess boundary. User skills (<home>/skills) win over the
213	    // source checkout; a missing file falls back to the built-in contract at read
214	    // time, so installed binaries without either tier still run.
215	    let skill_path = resolve_skill_path(paths, &options.skill_name);
216	    let now = Utc::now();
